case.trigger_text: Customer C07297 message: 'I never made this $482.12 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3476682.
case.analyst_notes: The $482.12 online purchase is well above the customer's average spend and follows a burst of similar‑sized online transactions, raising suspicion of card testing or account takeover. The customer has explicitly denied making the purchase, adding strong fraud indication.

evidence_requests.question: Can you confirm whether you authorized a $482.12 online purchase on the date of the transaction?
evidence_requests.simulated_response: I did not make that purchase. It looks like someone has accessed my account.
